citations.quote: A licensed attorney in Nevada since 2003, Brewer has practiced family law for over 20 years, driven by a desire to advocate for children and families.

She co-founded the Brewer Blau Law Group (2009–2016) and has contributed to significant legal discussions, including co-authoring a 2013 amicus brief presented to the Nevada Supreme Court on custody outcomes.
Her professional experience includes serving as a Truancy Diversion Judge, Parent Coordinator, Guardian ad Litem, and Pro Bono Settlement Master.
